versions.changelog:
greenhelix-agent-finops-playbook v1.3.1

- Added OpenClaw environment metadata to SKILL.md, specifying required environment variables and primary credential.
- No changes to guide content or code examples.
- Maintains compatibility and user experience; enhances integration clarity for OpenClaw deployers.

AI Agent FinOps Playbook v1.3.0

- Added sandbox instructions: you can now use https://sandbox.greenhelix.net with 500 free credits and no API key needed to get started.
- Updated the guide and introductory notice to clarify that examples use the GreenHelix sandbox.
- No changes to code examples or functionality—documentation improvements only.
- Version bump to 1.3.0 to reflect public sandbox onboarding instructions.

Version 1.2.0 of greenhelix-agent-finops-playbook

- Updated credential requirements to explicitly reference `GREENHELIX_API_KEY` and add `AGENT_SIGNING_KEY` for Ed25519 request signing.
- Revised documentation to clarify credential usage and security details.
- No code or API usage changes; educational examples and guide content remain the same.
- Improved clarity for users about what is required to implement examples in their own environments.

- Price reduced to free ($0.00); the guide is now fully accessible at no cost.
- Clarified that this is an educational/non-executable guide—no credentials or installation required.
- Updated description for accuracy; highlighted that code examples are illustrative.
- Added explicit "Notice" for users outlining execution and dependency expectations.
- Minor content and metadata adjustments to reflect the new usage model.

Initial release of the AI Agent FinOps Playbook for multi-agent systems.

- Provides a complete guide to cost governance for AI agents, including budget enforcement, cost allocation, and spend analytics.
- Covers per-agent wallets, budget caps, real-time spend alerts (via webhooks), cost attribution, volume discounts, fleet dashboards, and API key isolation.
- Includes production-ready Python code with full API integration.
- Designed for systems compatible with openclaw.
- Structured for practical deployment with both quick-start and deep-dive chapters.
